name: dbg
description: A universal CLI debugger interface that gives AI agents direct visibility into runtime state across multiple debugging protocols. Enables agents to inspect variables, set breakpoints, and analyze execution flow instead of guessing from source code.
community_quotes: Give your AI agent eyes into runtime state instead of guessing from source code
One CLI. Every debugger

name: SenWeaverCoding
description: A Rust-first autonomous AI agent runtime and CLI code editor built on SenAgentOS. Applies Harness Engineering to code engineering with autonomous exploration, refactoring, testing, and debugging capabilities.
community_quotes: Performance, stability, security – fully harnessed
Orchestrate LLM agents for autonomous exploration, refactoring, testing, and debugging

name: ZooClaw
description: A proactive team of AI specialists in one place. Acts as a single entry point to multiple AI agents with structured domain expertise, automatically routing tasks to the right agent with natural language input.
community_quotes: Your proactive team of AI specialists in one place
Zero token anxiety

name: RunawayContext
description: A universal framework for giving AI coding assistants persistent memory and project intelligence across sessions. Provides workspace-scoped memory that survives chat sessions and enables context-aware decision making.
community_quotes: Universal framework for giving AI coding assistants persistent memory and project intelligence across sessions

name: Claude Code Voice Mode
description: Voice mode for Claude Code that allows developers to speak their prompts instead of typing them. Reached #1 Product of the Day on April 2, 2026.
community_quotes: #1 Product on Product Hunt on April 2, 2026
Allows users to speak their prompts into Claude Code

name: cheetahclaws
description: CheetahClaws (Nano Claude Code) is a fast, easy-to-use, Python-native personal AI assistant for any model. Inspired by OpenClaw and Claude Code, it's built to work autonomously 24/7 with minimal resource requirements.
community_quotes: Nano Claude Code: A Fast, Easy-to-Use, Python-Native Personal AI Assistant
Built to Work for You Autonomously 24/7

name: CoreCoder
description: Minimal AI coding agent (~950 LoC Python) inspired by Claude Code. Works with any LLM and provides a clean, readable implementation of the core coding agent architecture. Think NanoGPT for coding agents.
community_quotes: Think NanoGPT for coding agent
Minimal AI coding agent (~950 LoC Python) inspired by Claude Code

name: nanocode
description: A lightweight AI coding assistant built in Python (~1.9k lines). Provides a minimal but functional implementation of an AI coding assistant with tool use and agentic workflows.
community_quotes: Lightweight AI coding assistant built in Python

name: Cursor 3
description: Unified workspace for parallel local/cloud agents and MCPs (Model Context Protocol). A major update to the Cursor AI IDE enhancing it with multi-agent capabilities and parallel execution.
community_quotes: Unified workspace for parallel local/cloud agents and MCPs

name: Viktor
description: An AI coworker that lives in Slack and automates workflows by observing team behavior. Proactively suggests automations and has context from tools and conversations, running autonomously without manual setup.
community_quotes: An AI coworker that actually does the work
Viktor doesn't just wait for you to ask. It observes how your team works and chimes in

name: traceAI
description: Open-source LLM tracing framework designed specifically for GenAI applications. Captures every LLM call, prompt, token count, retrieval step, and agent decision as structured traces.
community_quotes: Open-source LLM tracing that speaks GenAI, not HTTP

name: CCX-RS
description: Community Claude Code eXtended — a free, open-source AI coding assistant implemented in Rust. Features 19 tools, multi-model support (Claude/OpenRouter/Ollama), and a Claude Code-style TUI interface.
community_quotes: Community Claude Code eXtended — free, open-source AI coding assistant in Rust
19 tools, multi-model (Claude/OpenRouter/Ollama), Claude Code-style TUI

name: Baton
description: A desktop app for developing with AI coding agents. Run multiple agents in parallel, each in their own git-isolated workspace. Provides PR-ready code review capabilities with parallel agent execution.
community_quotes: Run multiple agents in parallel
Each agent operates in its own isolated git workspace

name: ToFu
description: Self-hosted AI assistant with tool use, multi-agent orchestration, coding copilot and a lightweight Flask + vanilla JS stack. Provides a complete self-hosted solution for teams wanting to control their AI infrastructure.
community_quotes: Self-hosted AI assistant with tool use, multi-agent orchestration, coding copilot
